title: Best AI Chatbot Plugins for WordPress in 2026 (5 Compared)
summary: Compare five WordPress AI chatbot plugins: free AI limits, commercial pricing, your own API keys, WooCommerce support, and the steps to install one.
body_markdown:
The best AI chatbot plugin for WordPress depends on whether you need answers from your site content, a human chat inbox, a conversational form, or actions such as looking up an order. A free plugin download does not tell you how much AI usage is included, and a chatbot managed in WordPress can still send requests to an external AI provider.


This comparison covers **Quickchat AI, WPBot, Tidio, Jotform AI Chatbot, and ChatBot.com** . It separates installation, free AI allowances, and billing units so you can choose a tool before following the[WordPress chatbot installation guide](https://quickchat.ai/post/ai-chatbot-for-wordpress) . Product and pricing details were checked against the linked vendor pages on **October 14, 2026** . This is a documentation-based comparison, not a performance benchmark of all five products.


**Optional example checks**


-


[Compare supplied pricing quotes](https://app.quickchat.ai/v1/api_core/public-question/quickchat/tools/quote-comparison/lab/post/?placement=www-wordpress-options-quote-comparison-post-v1) . Normalize declared pricing assumptions and flag missing inputs. This does not fetch vendor prices or supply a commercial quote.


-


[Check plan requirements](https://app.quickchat.ai/v1/api_core/public-question/quickchat/tools/plan-fit/lab/post/?placement=www-wordpress-options-plan-fit-post-v1) . Compare declared usage, content, team and feature needs with public Quickchat AI plan bundles. This is not a price quote or account check.


## WordPress AI chatbot comparison


The prices below are advertised USD entry points. Billing period, AI add-ons, and usage limits affect the final price. A message, conversation, resolution, and user license are different units; do not compare their allowances as if they were interchangeable.


Tool Installation and management Free AI allowance Paid entry point Main billing unit


[Quickchat AI](https://quickchat.ai/ai-chatbot-for-wordpress) Official plugin; agent managed on a hosted platform 50 AI credits/month for personal, non-commercial use Starter $9/month for commercial use; Enterprise from $0.50/resolution with a 2,000/month minimum AI credits; Enterprise resolutions


[WPBot](https://wordpress.org/plugins/chatbot/) Plugin managed in WordPress; connect your own AI provider Free plugin features; external AI usage is separate Pro license where required, plus provider API charges Plugin license and provider usage


[Tidio](https://www.tidio.com/pricing/) Hosted live chat and Lyro AI connected to your site 50 Lyro conversations, one-time Lyro advertised from $32.50/month; check billing period and any separate live-chat plan AI conversations; human conversations metered separately


[Jotform AI Chatbot](https://wordpress.org/plugins/jotform-ai-chatbot/) WordPress plugin connected to Jotform’s hosted service Starter plan with usage limits Paid Jotform tier as usage grows AI conversations, sessions, and other plan limits


[ChatBot.com](https://www.chatbot.com/pricing/) Hosted AI agent and team inbox 14-day trial Essential $25/user/month, or $19 with annual billing User licenses and included AI resolutions


Choose a shortlist based on the work your visitors need done:


- **Questions about your help content across several channels:** evaluate Quickchat AI.
- **Bot settings inside WordPress and your own provider account:** evaluate WPBot.
- **A human live-chat inbox with AI answering some conversations:** evaluate Tidio or ChatBot.com.
- **Conversational forms and a Jotform-based workflow:** evaluate Jotform AI Chatbot.


## Hosted AI and a WordPress-managed plugin


**A hosted AI service** keeps the agent’s knowledge, settings, and reply generation on the vendor’s platform. WordPress displays a widget. You maintain the connection and the content you give the agent, while the vendor operates the AI service. Conversation processing therefore involves that service.


**A WordPress-managed chatbot** puts more configuration and maintenance in` wp-admin` . With WPBot, you can configure scripted responses and connect an external AI provider. Managing the plugin on your own server does not mean that AI inference stays there: requests to the chosen provider leave your WordPress host.


Both approaches add browser resources. Measure page performance with your theme, hosting, and optimization plugins before selecting one on speed grounds.


## Quickchat AI


Quickchat AI connects a hosted agent through its[official WordPress plugin](https://wordpress.org/plugins/quickchat-ai-agent/) . The plugin displays the chat widget; you manage the Knowledge Base, behavior, and appearance in the Quickchat AI App. The same agent can connect to messaging and helpdesk channels, which is useful when WordPress is one of several places visitors contact you.


Add your help pages, policies, or documents to the Knowledge Base before testing the widget. For tasks that need live data, such as an order lookup, configure an AI Action separately. The[guide to connecting an AI agent to an API](https://quickchat.ai/post/connect-ai-agent-to-any-api) covers that distinction; installing the WordPress plugin alone does not connect your WooCommerce orders.


### Installation


You need WordPress 6.0 or newer, permission to install plugins, and an agent’s Scenario ID.


1. In WordPress, open **Plugins → Add New** , search for **Quickchat AI Agent** , then install and activate it.
2. In the Quickchat AI App, open **Channels → Your Website → Install** and copy the Scenario ID.
3. In WordPress, open **Settings → Quickchat AI Agent** , paste the ID, and save.
4. Open a public page and ask a question covered by your Knowledge Base.


*The plugin connects WordPress to your agent with a Scenario ID.*


*Copy the Scenario ID from the agent’s installation screen.*


*Test an answer on the public site after saving the connection.*


The[WordPress channel documentation](https://docs.quickchat.ai/channels/wordpress/) explains cache exclusions, blockers, HTTPS, and Content Security Policy requirements if the widget does not appear. Update appearance and knowledge on the platform after installation.


### Pricing and limits


The[current Quickchat AI pricing](https://quickchat.ai/pricing) gives the Free plan **50 AI credits per month for personal, non-commercial use** . A standard-model reply uses one credit; other model choices can use more. Commercial use starts with **Starter at $9/month** , including 150 credits. URL auto-refresh starts on paid plans, so account for how you will keep policies current.


Enterprise pricing starts at **$0.50 per resolution** , with a **2,000-resolution monthly minimum** and custom terms. It is a different billing model from the credit-based plans. Evaluate the included volume and terms for your site rather than applying the Enterprise unit price to a small site’s monthly usage.


## WPBot


WPBot is configured in WordPress and supports both scripted interactions and connections to external AI providers. Its directory listing describes FAQ responses, conversational forms, provider integrations, and site-content training. Advanced training and other features depend on the edition and setup you choose.


The free plugin and an AI provider’s paid usage are separate. Check the edition needed for your knowledge sources and any WooCommerce features, then include provider charges in your estimate. You also maintain the WordPress plugin and its provider credentials. This suits a team that wants configuration in` wp-admin` and is comfortable operating that connection.


## Tidio


Tidio combines a human chat inbox with Lyro AI. Its pricing distinguishes human **billable conversations** from **Lyro AI conversations** . A human conversation counts when a team member replies; Lyro’s allowance is a separate meter.


The included **50 Lyro conversations are a one-time allowance** , not 50 free AI conversations every month. The pricing page advertises standalone Lyro from **$32.50/month for 50 conversations** ; select your billing period and check whether you also need a paid live-chat plan. Evaluate it when the human inbox and AI handoff are part of the same workflow.


## Jotform AI Chatbot


Jotform’s WordPress plugin connects to a hosted service and advertises content training, conversational forms, and WooCommerce product questions, order tracking, and cart recovery. Those features make it relevant when your site already uses Jotform for structured submissions.


The[AI Agents pricing documentation](https://www.jotform.com/ai/agents/pricing/) lists a free Starter plan and paid tiers. Check both **monthly conversations** and **monthly sessions** : sessions can include chatbot views or page refreshes even without an active conversation. Verify the limits for your account rather than treating a free plugin download as unlimited AI usage.


## ChatBot.com


ChatBot.com currently presents an AI agent and team inbox offering with a **14-day trial** . Essential costs **$25/user/month** , or **$19 with annual billing** , and includes 10 AI resolutions per month. Growth costs $99/user/month, or $79 with annual billing, and includes 200. Extra packs of 50 resolutions are listed at $49.50.


Model both the number of teammates and the number of resolved questions. For example, one Growth user on annual billing with 500 monthly resolutions would need six additional 50-resolution packs beyond the included 200: $297 in packs plus the $79 monthly-equivalent seat price. This arithmetic describes the listed allowance, not a claim that the product will resolve every conversation you send it.


## Test a chatbot against your site’s questions


Use the same small test set on each shortlisted tool. This makes differences in content handling and workflow visible before you commit to a plan.


Test What to check


A shipping or returns question The answer matches the current policy you supplied


A question missing from your content The bot admits the gap and offers a useful next step


A request to speak to a person The configured handoff reaches the right team


An order-status question Public information and a live, authorized order lookup are handled appropriately


A policy you have just changed You can update the knowledge source and verify the new answer


Also open the widget on a mobile device and test it with your caching setup. Record the reply count or conversation volume in the vendor’s actual billing unit; a 1,000-conversation month can contain several thousand AI replies.


Once you have selected a tool, follow its installation steps, add your site’s content, and test a real visitor question. For Quickchat AI, the installation guide linked at the start covers the full setup. Choose a plan that permits your intended use and leaves enough AI allowance for the traffic you expect.


## WordPress chatbot FAQ


### What is the best AI chatbot for WordPress?


Choose by the job you need it to do. Quickchat AI connects a hosted agent trained on your content through an official plugin. WPBot lets you manage the bot in WordPress and connect your own AI provider. Tidio combines live chat with Lyro AI, Jotform fits conversational forms and WooCommerce workflows, and ChatBot.com combines an AI agent with a team inbox. Compare AI allowances, commercial-use terms, and the cost at your expected volume.


### Is there a free AI chatbot for WordPress?


There are free plugins and limited AI allowances, but the plugin price is only part of the cost. Quickchat AI’s Free plan includes 50 AI credits per month for personal, non-commercial use; commercial use starts with the $9/month Starter plan. Tidio includes 50 Lyro conversations as a one-time allowance. WPBot can connect to external AI providers, whose API charges are separate. Jotform has a free Starter plan with usage limits.


### Do AI chatbot plugins slow down WordPress?


A hosted service keeps AI processing outside WordPress, but its widget still downloads and runs in the visitor’s browser. A plugin managed inside WordPress can also add work on your hosting. Test the same pages on mobile before and after installation, including with your caching or optimization plugin enabled. This comparison does not provide measured speed benchmarks for these products.


### Can an AI chatbot answer from my website’s content?


Yes, if you add that content as knowledge and the selected product and plan support it. Quickchat AI imports pages and documents into its Knowledge Base. WPBot offers site-content training features whose availability depends on the edition and provider setup. Test questions about your own policies, and check how content changes are refreshed, rather than assuming that installing a plugin trains the AI automatically.


### Which AI chatbot plugin works with WooCommerce?


Jotform’s plugin advertises product questions, order tracking, and cart recovery. WPBot also advertises WooCommerce features in its Pro offering. Quickchat AI’s WordPress plugin displays the agent’s widget; a live order lookup requires a separately configured AI Action connected to your order system. Distinguish answers from public product and policy pages from actions that read a customer’s private order.


### Do I need an API key to add an AI chatbot to WordPress?


Quickchat AI’s official plugin needs your Scenario ID, not an AI provider key. Hosted services manage their model connection on the platform. With WPBot, you configure an external AI provider in the plugin and pay its API charges separately. An API subscription is a separate cost from the WordPress plugin license.
